## FAQ

Do you offer third-party integrations?

Yes. Visit our [Partner marketplace](https://marketplace.fundraiseup.com/) to explore integrations built by our partners.

How do your CRM integrations work?

Fundraise Up CRM integrations are native, API-based integrations that programmatically sync data to your CRM in real time.

Do I have to pay to use integrations?

No, all integrations are available to you at no cost.

What if my CRM isn’t listed as an integration?

If we don’t currently support your fundraising CRM, you can still connect Fundraise Up using Zapier or our JavaScript API to build a custom integration. Learn more in our [integration documentation](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/develop/).

Can I use Fundraise Up without a CRM?

Yes, Fundraise Up is fully functional without a connected CRM. If you add a CRM after you start using Fundraise Up, you can back-sync historical transactions to your CRM.

Can I connect Fundraise Up to other apps?

Yes, using Zapier, you can connect Fundraise Up to thousands of apps including CRMs, marketing platforms, automation tools, and more. You can also use our JavaScript API to build a custom integration.

Does Fundraise Up integrate with Salesforce?

Yes. Fundraise Up offers native integrations with standard Salesforce, Salesforce NPSP, and Nonprofit Cloud, syncing donation data in real time with no custom development required.

Does Fundraise Up integrate with HubSpot?

Yes. Fundraise Up has a native integration with HubSpot that syncs donation and supporter data in real time.

Does Fundraise Up integrate with Raiser’s Edge NXT?

Yes, through one of our integration partners. Fundraise Up doesn’t connect to Raiser’s Edge NXT natively, but partners like SimpliPhi and Brightvine offer real-time syncing between the two systems.

Does Fundraise Up integrate with Mailchimp?

Not natively today. You can connect Fundraise Up to Mailchimp using Zapier to automate the data sync between the two platforms.

Is there support available if something goes wrong during setup or migration?

Yes. Every customer has access to our documentation, in-app guidance, and support team. Depending on your plan, you may also have a dedicated Customer Success Manager for hands-on help with setup and migration.

What is Fundraise Up’s pricing?

Fundraise Up is free to start — no setup fees, fixed subscriptions, or long-term contracts. We invest in helping you grow, and our industry-leading fee coverage helps donors offset both Fundraise Up and payment processing costs. The result: an effective Fundraise Up cost of around 1% on average after fee coverage.
